email_source.name: Outlook Email
email_source.note: Scans Outlook mail via Graph Mail.Read for WW-window updates. Requires the cached refresh token to include Mail.Read (re-seed via IRE-SharePoint.ps1 -Action GetToken if a scope/403 warning appears).

calendar_source.name: Outlook Calendar
calendar_source.note: Reads meeting contents from the LOCAL Outlook client via COM (pywin32) - NO Graph Calendars.Read permission needed. Requires desktop Outlook + pywin32. lookahead_days=0 keeps meetings clamped to the Thu-Wed reporting window so consecutive weeklies do not overlap; raise it only if you want an upcoming-meetings preview (which will overlap the next report).

transcript_source.name: Meeting Transcripts
transcript_source.note: Captures Teams meeting transcripts (VTT) via Graph. DELEGATED = ORGANIZER-ONLY and requires the meeting to have been transcribed. Needs OnlineMeetingTranscript.Read.All + Calendars.Read consent on the cached token (re-seed via IRE-SharePoint.ps1 -Action GetToken). Saved under out_dir; a short deterministic summary appears in the weekly. Enable once the token consents the transcript scope.
